title: Flying in India this winter: fog, airport closures and your rights
dek: Smog and fog delays at Delhi, a six-hour shutdown at Mumbai on 19 November, and the refund rules every flyer should know.
seoTitle: Flying in India winter 2026: fog delays, Mumbai closure
bigLabel: Both runways at Mumbai airport close from 11 am to 5 pm on Thursday 19 November for annual maintenance, says the airport operator

glance.what: Winter is the hardest season for flying in north India. Smog and fog cut visibility, and airports switch to slower low-visibility procedures. Delhi's airport used them for the first time this season on Diwali night, and close to half of its departures were delayed the next day.
glance.why: Delays at Delhi spread across the country because so many flights pass through it. Mumbai, India's second-busiest airport, will also stop all flights for six hours on 19 November for runway repairs after the monsoon.
glance.next: Mumbai's shutdown on 19 November. Dense fog usually peaks in December and January.

keyNumbers.label: Free change window
keyNumbers.note: after booking, DGCA rule since 26 Mar

forYou: Flying on 19 November via Mumbai? Check with your airline whether your flight has moved. In fog season, check flight status before leaving home, especially for early-morning flights in north India. Under DGCA rules in force since 26 March 2026, you can cancel or change a ticket within 48 hours of booking without a cancellation charge (conditions apply); after that, normal charges apply. If the airline cancels your flight, you can ask for a refund or another flight.

events.title: Last winter: fog cancels more than 100 Delhi flights
events.summary: Background: on one of last winter's worst fog days, at least 128 flights were cancelled and about 200 delayed at Delhi airport as visibility collapsed. It shows how bad a peak fog day can get.

events.title: New refund rules for air tickets take effect
events.summary: DGCA rules issued on 24 February take effect. Passengers can cancel or change a ticket within 48 hours of booking without a cancellation charge; after that, normal charges apply. The rules also set deadlines for refunds and apply to Indian and foreign airlines flying to and from India.

events.title: Mumbai airport announces a six-hour shutdown
events.summary: Mumbai International Airport Ltd says both runways will close from 11 am to 5 pm on Thursday 19 November for annual post-monsoon maintenance. Airlines were given six months' notice to change schedules, and a notice to pilots has been issued. The airport handles nearly 1,000 take-offs and landings on a typical day.

events.title: Delhi airport's first low-visibility procedures of the season
events.summary: As smog and shallow fog cut visibility on Diwali night, Delhi airport switches to low-visibility procedures, which space flights further apart. About 44% of departures between midnight on 8 November and 8 pm on 9 November are delayed, by about 20 minutes on average.

events.title: US flights halted for four hours
events.summary: A nationwide ground stop in the US, from 2:24 am to 6:45 am India time, cancels thousands of flights. Travellers flying to or from the US this weekend should check their connections. See the full timeline of the US ground stop.
